descripcion:
NAOS. Choose friction.

Cella ranks 10 ways you overthink one text, by the minutes they eat. One "ok." with a period, 6:47 pm to 11:03 pm. Send it to the friend who answers with a period.

0:00 The text
0:29 #10 The reread (6:47 pm)
1:06 #9 The tone expert (6:49 pm)
1:47 #8 The poll (6:53 pm)
2:27 #7 The detective (7:01 pm)
3:00 #6 The rehearsal (7:13 pm)
3:36 #5 The drafts (7:31 pm)
4:17 #4 Too many replies (7:56 pm)
4:58 #3 The spotlight (8:29 pm)
5:39 #2 The waiting game (9:11 pm)
6:16 #1 The audit (10:03 pm)
7:01 #0 The plan (10:58 pm)
7:46 The last line (11:03 pm)

You'll recognize at least three.

What the research says (so you can check us):
Reading tone in email: Kruger, Epley, Parker & Ng (2005). Egocentrism over e-mail: Can we communicate as well as we think? Journal of Personality and Social Psychology, 89(6), 925-936.
The spotlight effect: Gilovich, Medvec & Savitsky (2000). The spotlight effect in social judgment. Journal of Personality and Social Psychology, 78(2), 211-222.
Too many options: Iyengar & Lepper (2000). When choice is demotivating. Journal of Personality and Social Psychology, 79(6), 995-1006.
Making a plan: Masicampo & Baumeister (2011). Consider it done! Plan making can eliminate the cognitive effects of unfulfilled goals. Journal of Personality and Social Psychology, 101(4), 667-683.

This is satire about habits, and a habit is not a diagnosis. If your head feels louder than a habit, talk to someone you trust.

#overthinking #selfawareness #NAOS
alt: An 8-minute video in 16:9 about one evening, from 6:47 pm to 11:03 pm. Cella, a small blocky black figure with two round white eyes and a red crown, stands in colored rooms. A friend named Mina answers a dinner invitation with one word: ok, with a period. Eleven chapters, from #10 to #0: in each one a question with four answer cards A to D, a poll, a chat or two clocks, and Cella picks. A dotted draft box on the floor stays empty until the last scene, where Cella sends the honest line and the words Choose friction. appear. The thumbnail shows Cella large with her red crown on a mint field, the words You overthink one text, Ranked by Cella, a yellow Dinner Saturday? bubble, 4:16, and a big white ok. with a red period.
comentario_fijado: How many times did you reread it before you answered? Be honest, we won't tell.
